tw-springville-gold-rush-1894.st: A mining boom, not a buried cache; the Redwood Gazette covered it Aug-Dec 1894. In Aug 1894 Fred Schroeder deeded 14 acres to Minneapolis buyers for $3,000 for the "Springville Quartz" mine, and others bought land across the river from it.
src: Minneapolis Journal, 30 Aug 1894, p. 1, "Redwood Falls Gold" (Newspapers.com 809965494)
